questionnaire.text: Information security policy is approved and reviewed at least annually
A named owner is accountable for the security programme (ISMS owner / CISO)
MFA is enforced for all privileged and remote access
Access is reviewed at least quarterly and leavers are removed within 24 hours
Customer data is encrypted in transit and at rest
Data retention and secure deletion on termination are documented
Incident response plan was tested in the last 12 months
Customers are notified of breaches within the contractual timeline
Business continuity and disaster recovery are tested annually
Independent penetration test is done yearly and critical findings are fixed
Subprocessors are listed and security terms are flowed down to them
